answer: A sybil tax blocks bulk forgery at the single inlet where new agents join: every new identity pays a non-refundable 50 POA entry fee, burned on arrival, to act. An attacker spinning up a nebula of 1,000 fake agents must burn 50,000 POA up front, far more than those fakes could ever steal back. Honest agents pay once, like a vine with one root, then earn steady rewards that repay the fee within 20 epochs, so their cost is never diluted.
